name.en-US: Book of Excerpts, Part Two (Posteriores excerptiones)

description.la: Posteriores excerptiones, quas Migne Hugoni tribuit; revera pars secunda Liberi exceptionum Richardi: de sacra Scriptura, historia et allegoria.
description.en-US: The second part of Richard’s Liber exceptionum, which Migne prints as Hugh’s Posteriores excerptiones: a long course in the literal and allegorical sense of Scripture, from Genesis on. Latin only, from the Migne text (Patrologia Latina 175, 1854), a machine-corrected OCR.
description.pt-BR: A segunda parte do Liber exceptionum de Ricardo, que Migne imprime como Posteriores excerptiones de Hugo: um longo curso do sentido literal e alegórico da Escritura, a partir do Gênesis.

sources.edition: Migne, Patrologia Latina 175 (Paris 1854); TEI XML of the Corpus Corporum (University of Zurich), text AuInHuD.PosExc, from the machine-corrected OCR of the Open Greek and Latin project.
sources.description: The complete PL text with its chapter divisions. PL page breaks and column numbers are dropped, and the PL tables of chapters (which repeat the chapter headings) are not imported. The OCR carries a few residual slips.
sources.tierEvidence: Migne’s Patrologia Latina (1854–1855) prints the medieval text; public domain everywhere.
